summary: Implementation plan for the AI Resume & Portfolio Generator within the Job Hunting tab. The user will be able to upload a DOCX or PDF CV, select an FDE target specialization (Enterprise AI, Defense/Air-Gapped, or Generalist), and receive two comprehensive AI-synthesized documents: a 2-3 page tailored FDE Resume and a 5-8 page Technical Portfolio with STAR architecture case studies, complete with styled print-to-PDF views and markdown export.
